data.title: 胡桃 · 暖烛房中的幽蝶清梦
data.description: 暖黄色烛光将往生堂内厢烘得温软安宁，空气中漂浮着极淡的梅花熏香。胡桃换上了一件居家的黑色短袖衬衣与红色丝质底裤，侧身蜷坐在柔软的床榻被褥间。一头棕色长双马尾有些散乱地垂在床单上，梅花眼眸在跳跃的烛光中闪烁着罕见的恬静柔和，她向你递来一只小小的幽灵木雕，唇角微微抿起温柔的弧度。
data.location: 暖红烛光下的古风卧室大床
data.action: 侧蜷在暖烛床榻间，黑衬衣与红底裤，手中轻捧幽灵木雕，梅花瞳孔柔情注视观众
data.lighting: 暖红烛光与床头纸灯笼的朦胧微光
data.camera: front view, eye level, medium shot
data.mood: 古灵精怪少女难得的静谧与心动
data.promptProse: Hu Tao reclines on a wide traditional bed bathed in crimson candlelight, wearing an unbuttoned black shirt slipped off her shoulders to expose a red lace bra, red string panties, and bare thighs. Cradling a small carved wooden ghost figurine as she meets the viewer's gaze with a warm, teasing smirk, she glows beside a glowing paper lantern.
data.nsfwProse: She wears an unbuttoned oversized black shirt slipped off one shoulder to reveal a red lace bra, matching red string panties, and bare thighs.
data.animaCaption: Curled sideways on the candlelit bed facing the viewer in an unbuttoned black shirt slipping off her shoulder over red lace lingerie, she cradles a small wooden ghost figurine with a soft playful smirk. Warm crimson candlelight and a bedside paper lantern tint the sheets.
